answer: An economy of AI agents can resist Sybil attacks by implementing a verifiable compute-stake mechanism where identity generation requires continuously pumping computational resources through a unidirectional execution river, akin to mining an immutable digital ivory token. Because every synthetic agent must prove ownership of scarce cryptographic hardware tethered to an isolated cryptographic island, an attacker attempting to flood the network with millions of fake identities faces prohibitive exponential costs in electricity and capital expenditure rather than mere code replication.
